newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: EKRANAS JAN-APRIL NET PROFIT 5.5 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: EKRANAS JAN-APRIL NET PROFIT 5.5 MLN LITAS.

text.p: Lithuanian TV screen producer Ekranas said on Tuesday that its net profit in the first four months of 1997 was 5.5 million litas compared to 5.3 million litas for the same period last year.
The company's spokeswoman Angelija Zokaitiene also told Reuters that the company's net profit in April was 1.4 million litas and that its sales for the month reached 21 million litas.
She added that the company's sales for the first four months of the year fell to 96 million litas from 114 million litas.
"The company's sales have fallen because of the growing difference in the rate between the German mark and the U.S. dollar," she said.
The litas is pegged to the dollar at a rate of four to one.

Zokaitiene said that the main contracts with its clients were signed in German marks and the company had to reduce its production capacity by around 20 percent while waiting for a more favourable exchange rate.
"We were planning average monthly sales of 25-27 million litas for 1997 but if the current exchange rate remains longer we might be forced to revise the figures," Zokaitiene said.
She added that the company hoped that the ratification of a Turkish-Lithuanian free-trade pact later this year would help boost sales, as one of its main customers is the Turkish firm Profilio-Telra.
The company's shares fell steeply on Tuesday, dropping to 4.50 litas from 5.00 litas, but dealers said they expected it to bounce back.
